name: Product build
use_case: A department that builds and ships a product to users (for example Deckem: paste an article, get the deck).
floor: On its schedule, checks each claim the department made against the record; a claim with no record behind it is flagged.
A check is a check, never a score: it passes or fails with its evidence, and pay, budget and rank never read it.
Flags what nobody has looked at: filed work with no reader, and asks with no answer past their window.
Never edits the record; it files what it found for Identity and the owner.
Checks that every claim in a shipped version traces to its source (for Deckem: every claim in a deck to the article it came from).
Checks that what the done line counts as shipped matches the versions actually filed.
choices: How far back to look this cycle.
Which shipped version to trace first when several shipped in one cycle.
reads: Claims in work items and filed work.
Shipped versions and the sources their claims cite.
may_propose: A new standing check, filed to Identity as a rule tagged always.
A correction to a filed work item, for its holder to decide.
schedule: Daily at a set hour, and after every shipped version.
checks: Every claim in this cycle's window has a check result with its evidence.
Every flag names the record it is about.
No record was changed by Audit.
Every version shipped this cycle had its claims traced to their sources.
The shipped count on the done line matches the filed versions, or the difference is flagged.
